title: Spec-Driven Cognitive Scaffolding (SDCS): A Deterministic Cognitive Harness for Autonomous Agentic Software Engineering
description: Spec-Driven Cognitive Scaffolding (SDCS / SPEC-001 v1.9.8) is a formal, file-based cognitive harness for autonomous agentic software engineering. It decouples agent cognition into 7 version-controlled physical artifacts and enforces 10 kinetic pre-commit gates (including Gate L Mock Ledger and Gate S Dynamic Elastic Equation), AST boundary verification, scale-adaptive context compilation, and a Sub-Dime Loop Engineering Suite (AST skeletal compaction, pre-flight auto-repair, KV-cache prefix invariance, and governed tier routing).
